exposureStatement: The author read only the two supplied policy/rubric files for task content. No historical cases, results, prompts, reviewer output, or other agents files were inspected during authoring.

implementationFreeze.basis: Parent task instruction reported that implementation and rubric were frozen remotely before this task; author did not inspect implementation.

noveltyStatement: These are newly authored texts for this experiment. Semantic novelty and training-data exclusion are not proven.
validation: All exemplar quotes were mechanically validated as unchanged contiguous substrings of one subject or body, with JavaScript UTF-16 length 4–120. Twenty IDs and four cases in each of five strata were validated.
preservation: No authored cases or labels were revised in producing this process record.
processRecordReads: author-inputs.json and author-labels.json read as raw bytes solely to compute SHA256.
